about.body: Shan-e-Lahore is a desi restaurant in Main Market, Gulberg II. Our day starts early with halwa puri, chanay and paye, and runs until midnight with karahi, handi, BBQ and tawa dishes.
The three words on our sign are ثقافت, اپنائیت and روایت: culture, belonging and tradition. We cook the dishes people in Lahore grew up with, and we try to make them taste the way they should.
This website is for home delivery. Our own riders deliver, and we call every customer to check the order and the address before we start cooking. You can also order by phone, or visit us in Gulberg.

info.contactIntro: Call us to order, to ask about an order, or with any question. If you've already ordered, keep your order number handy (it starts with SL).

terms.heading: Ordering
terms.body: This site takes delivery orders only. After you place an order, one of our staff calls you to confirm it before we start cooking. If we can't reach you after three calls, the order is cancelled.

terms.heading: Prices
terms.body: Menu prices include tax. The delivery charge depends on how far your map pin is from the restaurant, and you see it before you order. The total shown at checkout is what you pay.

terms.heading: Delivery area and timing
terms.body: We deliver to the area shown on the map at checkout. Delivery times are estimates; traffic, weather and busy hours can make us late.

terms.heading: Payment
terms.body: Pay cash to the rider, or by bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa. For transfers, the money has to reach our account before we confirm your order. If it hasn't arrived by the time we call, the order is cancelled.

terms.heading: Changes and cancelling
terms.body: You can cancel online until we call to confirm; after that, please call us. On the confirmation call our staff can change dishes or the address for you, and the total is updated.

terms.heading: Sold-out dishes
terms.body: Sometimes a dish runs out. If that happens after you order, we'll tell you on the call and you can choose something else.

terms.heading: Discount codes
terms.body: Each code has its own conditions, such as dates, a minimum order or one use per phone number. Only one code can be used per order.

terms.heading: Refusing orders
terms.body: We can refuse or cancel orders that look fake, and stop online orders from numbers that have placed fake orders before.

privacy.heading: What we ask for
privacy.body: To deliver your order we need your name, mobile number, address, a nearby landmark and a pin on the map. You can also add notes. We keep these with your order, along with what you ordered and how you paid.

privacy.heading: Who sees it
privacy.body: Our staff use your details to call you, cook and deliver. Your rider gets your name, number, address and pin. We don't sell your details or give them to anyone for advertising.

privacy.heading: Your order link
privacy.body: Anyone with your tracking link can see the order status, your first name, the dishes and the total, but not your address or your full phone number.

privacy.heading: On your phone
privacy.body: You don't need an account. The site keeps only your language and the dishes in your cart, in your own browser. There are no advertising cookies.

privacy.heading: Services we use
privacy.body: The site runs on Supabase (database) and Render (hosting). Cloudflare Turnstile checks that orders come from real people, and the maps come from OpenStreetMap. Each of them handles only what it needs to do its job.

privacy.heading: Questions
privacy.body: To ask what we hold about you, or to have your details removed, call us.

refund.heading: Cash on delivery
refund.body: You pay when the food arrives, so there's nothing to refund if a cash order is cancelled.

refund.heading: Bank, JazzCash and Easypaisa
refund.body: If an order you've already paid for is cancelled, either by you before we confirm it or by us, we refund the full amount to the account you paid from. Our staff will call you to arrange it.

refund.heading: Wrong or missing items
refund.body: Call us as soon as your order arrives and tell us what's wrong.
